## Here is our preliminary data cleaning

```{r}

# Read the file and assign it to a variable
data <- read.csv('../data/cleaned_batting_stats.csv')
```

```{r}
# Drop unneeded columns
data_new <- subset(data, select = c(RBI, Age, G, PA, BB, R, H, X2B, X3B, HR, SF, Lg, Year))
```


```{r}
# Fitting the model
model <- lm(RBI ~ Age + G + PA + BB + R + H + X2B + X3B + HR + SF + Lg * Year, data = data_new)
```
```{r}
plot(fitted(model), my_data$RBI,
     xlab = "Fitted RBI", ylab = "Actual RBI",
     main = "Actual vs. Fitted RBI",
     pch = 16, col = rgb(0, 0, 1, 0.3))
abline(0, 1, col = "red", lwd = 2)   # perfect-prediction line

plot(fitted(model), resid(model))

summary(model)
```


```{r}

data_new$Lg = factor(data_new$Lg)

pairs(data_new)
```
